children: Tata Consultancy Services Limited (NSE:TCS) is buying Germany’s MHP for €320M to add ~4,500 staff and an AI Mobility Centre while also issuing a LoI to Tejas Networks for a Rs 1,537 crore BSNL RAN order; shares slipped amid integration and revenue concerns, pay and H‑1B localization noted.
: TCS to buy Germany’s MHP for €320M, gaining ~4,500 staff. Deal needs regulatory approval, expected to close in 3–4 months. Includes five-year tech pact and AI Mobility Centre.
TCS Shares Edge Down On MHP Integration Risk
: TCS shares fell after early gains post-MHP buy; brokers flagged integration risk and uncertain MHP revenue. HSBC keeps Hold with Rs 2,350 target; Citi keeps Sell with Rs 1,825 target.
TCS To Supply RAN Gear For BSNL
: TCS issued a Letter of Intent to Tejas Networks to supply RAN gear and installation items for BSNL’s 4G rollout across 18,685 sites, a Rs 1,537 crore order; Tejas stock jumped ~10%.
TCS Q1 Variable Pay Below Peak
: TCS reported Q1 variable pay below the prior two quarters (peaked ~80%) but above year-ago; mid/senior payouts historically ranged 20–40% before Q1 FY26.
: Tata Consultancy Services Limited (TCS) reported that it has localized its American workforce, stating that only around 500 employees are currently traveling on H‑1B visas.
